Can I cancel an order after placing it, and is there a time window?

Hi! Yes — there is a time window 🙂

Under 45 minutes: you can usually cancel it yourself from your confirmation email using the “Edit or View your order” button
Between 45 minutes and 1 hour: we may be able to cancel it for you
After 1 hour: cancellations are no longer possible

If you want me to check a specific order, send your order number.

turns.q: Can I add an item to an order I already placed?
turns.replyTail:
! Sometimes, yes 🙂

Within 45 minutes of placing the order: you can usually add an item yourself through your confirmation email by clicking “Edit or View your order”
Between 45 minutes and 1 hour: we can’t add items directly, but you may still be able to cancel the order and place a new one
After 1 hour: changes usually aren’t possible because the order is already moving through processing

If you want, send me your order number and I can tell you what applies for your order.

What happens if it already shipped — can it still be changed?

Hi! Once an order has already shipped, it can’t be changed or canceled. 📦

That includes things like:

changing the shipping address
adding or removing items
canceling the order

If it’s already been delivered, you can return eligible items and place a new order instead. If you want, send me your order number and I can help you figure out what applies. 🙂

How do I update my contact or account details?

Hi! You can usually update your contact or account details in your account settings on simplemodern.com 🙂

If you’re able to log in:

Go to your account
Open your account settings
Update your information there

If you can’t access it or need help correcting something, send me the email tied to the account and I’ll point you in the right direction. Let me know if there’s anything else I can help with!
